query:
SELECT 
  'employeeCompetencies' as tabla,
  COUNT(*) as total_registros,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN employeeId IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_employeeId,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN competencyName IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_competencyName
FROM employeeCompetencies
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'jobProfiles' as tabla,
  COUNT(*) as total_registros,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN positionId IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_positionId,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN competencyName IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_competencyName
FROM jobProfiles;
